title: Public Platform Extraction V1 and Course Package Architecture V1

preflight.note: Created on the public feature branch from current public main d35510e before implementing the public platform and declarative course package boundary.

acceptance_criteria.text: Public SkillForge has one generic modern runtime boundary for courses, classroom, lectures, academic structure, instructor fallback, labs, persistence, and package context without private-course conditionals.

A canonical declarative .skillforge-course package contract, manifest, capability vocabulary, deterministic serialization, bounded size, cross-reference validation, and security rejection rules are implemented and tested.

Built-in public certification tracks use the same registry/package contracts as future installed packages while preserving existing content, learner state, backups, accessibility, mobile foundations, and build infrastructure.

CourseRegistry/package installation, update, removal, capability negotiation, and per-course learner-state namespacing are generic and do not execute package-provided code, commands, paths, or secrets.

Public privacy gates prove that no private course content, evidence, fixtures, screenshots, repository paths, private markers, or new personal-name references entered public source, history, fixtures, or evidence.

Public browser acceptance proves public course launch, generic Academy/Classroom/Lecture flow, deterministic fallback, package import/rejection, learner-state preservation, and multi-course state isolation.

Public-safe architecture, security, distribution, privacy-boundary, and Course Studio handoff documentation plus ADRs define the canonical authoring target without implementing the full Course Studio UI or marketplace.

source: Public Platform Extraction V1 + Course Package Architecture V1 request.
